label: development-control-plane runtime regression decision point

cumulative_events.event_summary: Repeated scheduled Standing Inbox processing of historical thinking-os repair requests produced recurring fail-closed evidence instead of allowing the scan to progress cleanly through all candidates.

The active Windows runtime checkout and Scheduled Task were inspected. The task runs from the development-control-plane checkout, and the affected GitHub CLI subprocesses did not explicitly request UTF-8 text decoding.
The working copy was changed so GitHub CLI subprocesses decode text as UTF-8 and one candidate-processing exception cannot abort the remainder of the inbox scan.
Focused activator and thinking-os repair regression tests passed 59 of 59.

The full development-control-plane suite passed 429 tests but failed 7 tests in the separate V2 test-release area. The failures all reported a fixed target-branch mismatch before the expected fake release-path assertions could run.
